Answer: B
Reason: The report for the initial image (Figure 1) identifies bilateral diffuse airspace opacities consistent with multifocal pneumonia or ARDS, while the final image (Figure 4a) shows interval improvement in these patchy opacities; this resolution pattern is most consistent with effective treatment of viral pneumonia among the choices, whereas EIPH and PE are unlikely to present with such extensive bilateral infiltrates that resolve in this manner. *(guided by t000006)*
